description: Quality Tools Configuration - Create missing quality tool configuration files: .nvmrc, .editorconfig, and verify/update existing configs (ESLint, Prettier, commitlint, Husky).
steps: Create .nvmrc file with Node.js version 22 (based on package.json engines: >=20.0.0 and CI using 22.x)
Create .editorconfig with consistent coding style settings matching existing .prettierrc (indent_size=2, charset=utf-8, etc.)
Review and enhance eslint.config.js if needed - ensure it covers all relevant file patterns
Verify .prettierrc settings are comprehensive (add proseWrap, endOfLine if missing)
Verify commitlint.config.js is properly configured for conventional commits
Verify .lintstagedrc.json covers all relevant file types
Create .prettierignore file if missing (should ignore node_modules, coverage, dist, etc.)
Create .eslintignore file if needed (or verify ignores in eslint.config.js)
acceptance_criteria: Prettier config has all necessary settings
All quality tools can run without errors
